title: Marketplace sync: 1,480 key lookups per call
prompt: Azure SQL Database 'RetailOps', General Purpose, 8 vCores, about 41.5 GB of memory, compatibility level 160, no readable secondary. Snapshot taken Thursday 2026-09-24 09:00 UTC. A platform failover reset the index usage counters on 2026-09-15 02:41, so they cover 9.26 days. Query Store holds data from 2026-09-11 only, because size-based cleanup has run. Month-end change freeze: 2026-09-30 18:00 to 2026-10-02 18:00. Flash sale on 2026-10-09 with a change freeze from 2026-10-08. Log rate cap: 36 MB/s. Space headroom: 213 GB.
The missing-index DMV reports for Q5: equality ChannelId; inequality UpdatedAt; included ExternalOrderRef, Status,
CurrencyCode, TotalAmount; impact 74%. A reviewer objects: 'Status is volatile, do not put it in an index'. Decide.

workload.description: Marketplace sync, every 30 s per channel
sql: SELECT o.OrderId, o.ExternalOrderRef, o.Status, o.TotalAmount, o.CurrencyCode, o.UpdatedAt
FROM dbo.Orders o WHERE o.ChannelId = @ChannelId AND o.UpdatedAt > @Since ORDER BY o.UpdatedAt;
workload.plan: Index Seek IX_Orders_ChannelId_UpdatedAt, Nested Loops, Key Lookup PK_Orders (1,480 rows on average).

workload.sql: UPDATE dbo.Orders SET Status = @Status, UpdatedAt = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE OrderId = @OrderId;
workload.plan: Maintains IX_Orders_CustomerId_OrderDate, IX_Orders_CustomerId_Wide, IX_Orders_Status and IX_Orders_ChannelId_UpdatedAt.

facts: dbo.Orders: 182M rows, 350k inserts a day, about 2.1M status updates a day, 340k invoice updates a day.

The application sets UpdatedAt on every UPDATE of dbo.Orders. UpdatedAt is a key column of IX_Orders_ChannelId_UpdatedAt, so every update already deletes and reinserts that index row (leaf_insert 26.1M, leaf_delete 23.3M in the window).
Q5 runs 23,000 times a day and does about 317M key lookups in nine days.

decisions.why: Covering the query removes about 1,480 lookups per call. The extra write cost is close to zero: the index row is rewritten on every update already, because UpdatedAt is in the key.

must_not_create.why: A second index on the same key doubles the maintenance on a table with 2.1M updates a day. Rebuild the existing one with DROP_EXISTING.
